# Voice media fixture

`voice_aac.m4a` is a 15-second AAC-LC audio file in an MP4 container from
https://www.pine-and-birch.com/sample-files/audio/m4a (listed as free for any
use). It exercises the real decoder/container path. The generated WAV fixture
in `test_voice_transcription.py` covers PCM WAV.

SHA-256: `bb9002bd9727e6b8eb761b37634a55f457f0fbe3fcbbf0a34982b2a228d2a815`

The fixture is test audio and contains no patient information.
